protocol: research_v3 sector_mom: short-term momentum rotation across A-share industry/theme ETFs, with daily moving-average exits
relation_to_other_work: Independent new experiment. Does not change the frozen CAP_DEF_M candidate. Goal is profit-seeking short-term momentum (holding days to weeks).

universe.candidates: All exchange-traded equity ETFs listed in Shanghai/Shenzhen whose tracked index is an industry or thematic index (e.g. semiconductors, securities, banks, military, healthcare, new energy, consumer, real estate, media, coal, nonferrous metals). Excluded: broad-market and size indices (e.g. SSE 50, CSI 300/500/1000/2000, ChiNext, STAR 50, SZSE 100, A50/A500), pure style/strategy indices (dividend, value, growth, low-vol, quality, ESG), cross-border/QDII and Hong Kong-linked ETFs, bond, gold, commodity and money-market ETFs.
universe.classification_procedure: Classify by the tracked index name/type from THS fund profile (or akshare if unavailable) using a written keyword rule; the rule and the full classified list (included and excluded, with reason) are produced and saved BEFORE any price data is downloaded or any return is computed.
universe.delisted: Include ETFs that have since been delisted if any source lists them; if no source provides delisted ETFs, state the survivorship bias explicitly.
universe.point_in_time_eligibility: At each weekly signal date an ETF is eligible only if: listed for at least 250 sessions, has a bar on the signal date, and its mean daily turnover (CNY) over the previous 60 sessions is at least 30,000,000.
universe.dedup_same_index: If several eligible ETFs track the same index, keep only the one with the highest 60-session mean turnover at that signal date.
universe.min_universe: Scoring starts at the first weekly signal date with at least 15 eligible ETFs after dedup.

data.primary: THS fund market historical daily bars (forward-adjusted, 5-year windows stitched), API key from .env FUYAO_API_KEY
data.fallback: akshare (Eastmoney hfq or Sina unadjusted + self-built adjustment as in research_v3/cn_transfer)
data.turnover: daily turnover in CNY from the same source
data.snapshot: all raw data saved with a sha256 manifest; runs verify hashes

periods.development_halves: development split at its midpoint date into DEV_A and DEV_B
periods.holdout: 2024-10-01 to 2026-09-30. Must not be loaded, scored, plotted or summarised until the one-time holdout run authorised by the user after candidate selection. Code must enforce this with a guard.

execution_model.weekly_schedule: signal at the close of the last session of each week; trades at the open of the next session
execution_model.daily_exit_check: at each session close; exit trade at the next session open
execution_model.t_plus_1: no position is sold on the session it was bought
execution_model.limit_rules: cannot buy if the open is at or above +limit (prev close * 1.10, or *1.20 for ETFs on 20% boards); cannot sell if the open is at or below -limit; blocked orders retry at each following open
execution_model.costs: commission 2.5 bp per side + slippage 10 bp per side (primary); sensitivity: 2.5 + 20 bp. No stamp duty for ETFs.
execution_model.capital: fractional shares, 1,000,000 CNY start (secondary: 100-share lots with min 5 CNY commission at 100,000 CNY)

strategies.S1_WEEKLY_MOM: score = mean(20-session return, 60-session return) on adjusted close at the signal close; eligible only if close > 20-session SMA; select top 5 by score; weights proportional to 1/sigma20 (std of 20 daily log returns), sum 1 if 5 selected, otherwise each unfilled slot's 1/5 stays cash; weekly rebalance.
strategies.S2_MA10_EXIT_WEEKLY_REENTRY: S1, plus: a held ETF whose close falls below its 10-session SMA is sold at the next open to cash; it can be re-bought only at the next weekly rebalance and only if it is selected AND its close is above its 10-session SMA at that signal.
strategies.S3_MA5_EXIT_WEEKLY_REENTRY: same as S2 with a 5-session SMA.
strategies.S4_MA10_EXIT_DAILY_REENTRY: S2, but an ETF exited by the MA10 rule is re-bought at the next open after any close back above its 10-session SMA, provided it is still in the latest weekly selection, at its latest weekly target weight.

benchmarks.EW_SECTOR: equal weight across all eligible deduplicated sector ETFs, rebalanced monthly (first session of each month), same eligibility rules

metrics: cost drag (CAGR with zero cost minus CAGR)
stationary block bootstrap (block 21, 2000 resamples, seed 20261019) 90% CI of excess Sharpe difference vs EW_SECTOR and vs CSI300_BH
PSR and DSR with N = number of strategies in this protocol (4)

conditions_all_required: DEV excess Sharpe > EW_SECTOR and > CSI300_BH (point estimates)
DEV max drawdown < CSI300_BH DEV max drawdown
excess Sharpe > EW_SECTOR in both DEV_A and DEV_B
conditions hold under the 2.5+20 bp sensitivity cost as well
candidate_selection_on_development_only.pick: among qualifiers, the one with the highest min(DEV_A, DEV_B) excess Sharpe; at most 1 candidate
candidate_selection_on_development_only.if_none: report that no strategy qualifies; the holdout is not run unless the user explicitly asks to run it for information only

holdout_run: One time only, after selection, for the single candidate and the two benchmarks, with the user's explicit go-ahead. Report all metrics regardless of outcome. No changes after seeing it.
freeze_rule: This protocol is frozen at commit time; any change is a separately labelled amendment written before the affected run.
